title: Elegant Studded Leather
summary: Light armour with base AC 14, +2 Initiative, advantage on Stealth and Shield.

fields.Armour Class: Light Armour, AC 14 plus Dexterity modifier.
fields.Shield: When about to be hit, spend a Reaction to gain +5 AC and immunity to Magic Missile until the start of your next turn. Tooltip recharge is Short Rest. The source reports Long Rest recharge unless the armour is unequipped and reequipped.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
